ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

LOCAL SPEED LIMIT (FEDERAL ROADS) (SARAWAK) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Local Speed Limit (Federal Roads)

(Sarawak) Order 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 24 May 2019.

Prohibition

2. The driving of motor vehicles at a speed greater than the speed specified in

column (2) of the Schedule on the road specified in column (1) of the Schedule

is prohibited.

SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 2]

 (1) (2)

starting from the wildlife sanctuary area

E 109.689737 (a distance of 1.069 km).
